# Aegryn — Swiss Tech Asset Builder
> https://aegryn.com

## What is Aegryn?

Aegryn (pronounced AY-grin) is a Swiss Tech Asset Builder incorporated in Switzerland. We design, fund and operate proprietary digital ecosystems — from the protocol layer to the user interface. Our model is based on full ownership, sovereign infrastructure and long-term value creation. We do not build MVPs. We build assets.

Tagline: "Engineered to Last" / "Building What Endures"
Founder & CEO: Yohann Bollack
Incorporated: Switzerland (Sàrl)
Contact: hello@aegryn.com

## Name Etymology

- AEGIS (αἰγίς) — divine shield of Zeus and Athena → absolute protection
- AEGIR (Ægir) — Norse god of the sea → mastery of flows
- AEON (αἰών) — eternity → Engineered to Last
Synthesis: "Aegryn protects what endures."

## Our Proprietary Assets

- **Subblink** (subblink.app) — B2B SaaS platform for AI-powered contract analysis. Helps enterprises detect risks, obligations and anomalies in legal documents.
- **Neediu** (neediu.com) — B2C marketplace connecting households with vetted home service providers. Cleaning, plumbing, childcare, and more.
- **Primiom** (primiom.com) — B2C AI-assisted real estate platform for buying, renting and estimating property value across Europe.
- **Movtoo** (movtoo.com) — B2C on-demand delivery platform for individuals and small businesses — fast, reliable, urban logistics.
- **Hobconnect** (hobconnect.com) — B2C social network built around shared passions and hobbies — connecting people through what they love.

Each asset operates independently and carries the tagline: "An Aegryn company."

## Advisory — Aegryn Advisory

Aegryn Advisory provides institutional-grade digital protection for enterprises:
- Cybersecurity — Attack surface audit, penetration testing, incident response, cloud & on-premise hardening.
- AI Audit & Trust — Algorithmic bias audit, EU AI Act compliance, LLM red-teaming, decision traceability.
- Digital Strategy — Data governance, GDPR & Swiss FADP compliance, secure architecture, innovation roadmap.

## Philosophy

Proprietary. Sovereign. Durable.
100% ownership. Swiss sovereignty. Engineered to Last.
We do not sell minority stakes to VCs. Every Aegryn asset is designed to be fully owned, sovereignly operated and passed to the next generation.

## Values

- Precision — Every decision is documented, measured and traceable.
- Durability — We build for the long term, not the next funding round.
- Sovereignty — Our assets, our infrastructure, our data. No critical external dependencies.
- Transparency — Towards our partners, users and the market.

## Geography & Compliance

Headquarters: Switzerland (Geneva)
Markets: Switzerland, France, Germany, Belgium, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, European Union
Regulatory: GDPR compliant, Swiss FADP (LPD) compliant, EU AI Act aligned
